stages.reference:
Create a close visual reference for the freshly exposed but weathered end-grain of an acacia trunk in a grounded dark-fantasy world.

Show the character of hard drought-grown wood: tight uneven growth rings, a dense darker heartwood, lighter dry sapwood, small radial checks and subtle staining from age and exposure. The tree should read as slow-grown and resilient, its history visible in compressed irregular rings rather than perfect concentric decoration.

Use restrained warm ochre, dusty orange-brown and deep muted heartwood tones. Avoid a clean sawmill sample, perfectly circular rings, giant cracks, glossy varnish or ornamental target-like geometry.

The reference should establish believable acacia end-grain as an aged game-world material. Do not reproduce any source composition; concentrate on material identity, growth history and physical depth.
